reason: The short two-frame result did not survive the predeclared eight-frame extension.
diagnosis: The displacement head improves a zero-motion sparse parent on the shortest window, but errors accumulate on dense 6bba transitions.
The center head is overconfident: raising the threshold from 0.50 to 0.70 removes few detections, while 0.97 is needed to control the node penalty.
The unfreeze-0 implementation froze the backbone but still optimized detect_head, so V6 was not a frozen-detector motion-only adaptation.
Training used a 0.001 negative center weight; the recorded center loss worsened from the first 100 to the last 100 steps.
The V6 released parent differs from the public 0.903 support checkpoint, so continued fine-tuning from this parent is not the strongest low-compute route.
A two-frame sparse-label clip is too small to establish lineage robustness even when edge Jaccard is perfect.

replacement_directions.name: public_0903_graph_pipeline
replacement_directions.action: Use the exact public detector and node-transformer checkpoint as the main path, retain its externally calibrated 0.97 threshold, and replace dense repair matrices with sparse physical-neighbor arcs.

replacement_directions.name: frozen_detector_motion_residual
replacement_directions.action: Freeze the public detector; train only a compact backward-motion or top-k edge residual head with hard dense-transition examples.

replacement_directions.name: scenario_router
replacement_directions.action: Route clean clips to low-TTA sparse linking and dense or low-SNR clips to D4 detection plus the learned graph solver; route confidence must be image-only.

replacement_directions.name: multi_hypothesis_gap_repair
replacement_directions.action: Add only sparse gap and division hypotheses, score them with image and geometry evidence, and solve a binary lineage forest globally.

literature.method: Malin-Mayor et al. binary lineage forest
